# ============================================================================
# DROP - WebView UI build configuration (generated by ui-finalization-agent
# from finalized mockup v10, 2026-09-14)
# ============================================================================
# This is a REFERENCE SNIPPET for Stage 1 Foundation / Stage 3 GUI Phase 4.1
# to fold into DROP's real top-level CMakeLists.txt (which does not exist
# yet - DROP has not reached Stage 1). It mirrors CORRUPTR's shipped,
# working CMakeLists.txt (plugins/CORRUPTR/CMakeLists.txt) - the closest
# real WebView-plugin precedent in this repo - adapted for DROP's own
# plugin identity, MIDI-trigger-note requirement (architecture.md MIDI
# Routing), and bundled marble asset.
#
# gui-agent: do not paste this file wholesale over a Stage-1-generated
# CMakeLists.txt - merge the juce_add_plugin()/target_sources()/
# target_link_libraries() blocks Stage 1 already created with the
# WebView-specific sections below (binary data target, WebView compile
# definitions).
# ============================================================================

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)

# Plugin formats: VST3 + Standalone everywhere; AU is macOS-only.
set(DROP_FORMATS VST3 Standalone)
if(APPLE)
    list(APPEND DROP_FORMATS AU)
endif()

juce_add_plugin(DROP
    COMPANY_NAME "VST Factory"
    PLUGIN_MANUFACTURER_CODE Vstf
    PLUGIN_CODE Drop
    FORMATS ${DROP_FORMATS}
    PRODUCT_NAME "DROP"
    # DROP is an audio EFFECT (Transition Engine), not an instrument -
    # IS_SYNTH is deliberately omitted/FALSE (juce8-critical-patterns.md #22
    # applies to instruments only). It DOES need MIDI input for the
    # configurable trigger note (architecture.md MIDI Routing: a single
    # configurable note-on fires the same action as the trigger parameter/
    # button) while still processing an audio signal, so NEEDS_MIDI_INPUT
    # is set without IS_SYNTH.
    NEEDS_MIDI_INPUT TRUE
    NEEDS_WEB_BROWSER TRUE   # REQUIRED for VST3 WebView support (Pattern #9)
    NEEDS_WEBVIEW2 TRUE      # Bundles the WebView2 loader on Windows (ignored on macOS)
)

# Source files - ASSUMPTION (flag for gui-agent): actual file list depends
# on Stage 1/2/3's real source tree; PluginEditor.cpp is the one this
# snippet's WebView config specifically depends on.
target_sources(DROP
    PRIVATE
        Source/PluginProcessor.cpp
        Source/PluginEditor.cpp
)

target_include_directories(DROP
    PRIVATE
        Source
)

# Required JUCE modules
target_link_libraries(DROP
    PRIVATE
        juce::juce_audio_basics
        juce::juce_audio_devices
        juce::juce_audio_formats
        juce::juce_audio_plugin_client
        juce::juce_audio_processors
        juce::juce_audio_utils
        juce::juce_core
        juce::juce_data_structures
        juce::juce_dsp
        juce::juce_events
        juce::juce_graphics
        juce::juce_gui_basics
        juce::juce_gui_extra   # WebView support
    PUBLIC
        juce::juce_recommended_config_flags
        juce::juce_recommended_lto_flags
        juce::juce_recommended_warning_flags
)

# Generate JuceHeader.h (JUCE 8 requirement)
juce_generate_juce_header(DROP)

# ============================================================================
# WebView UI Resources
# ============================================================================
# Source layout expected (Stage 3 GUI Phase 4.1, see v10-integration-checklist.md):
#   Source/ui/public/index.html                       <- copied from v10-ui.html
#   Source/ui/public/js/juce/index.js                  <- JUCE frontend library
#   Source/ui/public/js/juce/check_native_interop.js    <- required, Pattern #13
#   Source/ui/public/v10-marble2-texture-hd.jpg         <- copied from .ideas/mockups/
juce_add_binary_data(DROP_UIResources
    SOURCES
        Source/ui/public/index.html
        Source/ui/public/js/juce/index.js
        Source/ui/public/js/juce/check_native_interop.js
        Source/ui/public/v10-marble2-texture-hd.jpg
)

target_link_libraries(DROP
    PRIVATE
        DROP_UIResources
        juce::juce_gui_extra
)

# WebView support
target_compile_definitions(DROP
    PUBLIC
        JUCE_WEB_BROWSER=1
        JUCE_USE_WIN_WEBVIEW2=1                    # Windows: enables the WebView2 backend (resource provider API); no effect on macOS
        JUCE_USE_WIN_WEBVIEW2_WITH_STATIC_LINKING=1 # NEEDS_WEBVIEW2 links WebView2 statically - see CORRUPTR's identical precedent for why this define is required
        JUCE_USE_CURL=0
)
